headline: Current account surplus maintained during the third quarter: Banxico
summary: Banco de México reported a current account surplus of $1.142 billion in the third quarter of 2026, equal to 0.2% of GDP.
why: The current account measures a country's trade and income flows with the rest of the world, and shapes its external financing needs and currency pressure.
